question: Among the patients whose creatinine level is abnormal, how many of them aren't 70 yet?
evidence: creatinine level is abnormal refers to CRE >= 1.5; aren't 70 yet refers to SUBTRACT((YEAR(CURDATE()), YEAR(Birthday))) < 70;
clarification: Count every row, including repeated ID values.
gold: SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND STRFTIME('%Y', DATE('now')) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) < 70
gold0: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND STRFTIME('%Y', Date('now')) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) < 70

c.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient AS P INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5 AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)) < 70

d.request: Among the patients whose creatinine level is abnormal (CRE >= 1.5), how many are not yet 70 years old (YEAR(CURDATE()) minus YEAR(Birthday) is less than 70), counting every matching row, including rows with repeated ID values rather than only distinct patient IDs?
d.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory AS L INNER JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70

b.request: Count all Examination/Laboratory rows (not distinct patients) where CRE >= 1.5 and the patient's age, computed as the current year minus the birth year, is under 70, so a patient with several qualifying rows is counted once per row
b.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory AS L INNER JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70
